name: After § 18
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the joint communication on humanitarian aid (JOIN(2026)0025)
part_text: 18a. Calls for the EU and its Member States to focus their humanitarian aid on regions currently affected by immediate crises, with the primary objective of preventing illegal migration flows towards Europe by providing comprehensive support to refugees and internally displaced persons in their countries of origin or in safe areas in their immediate vicinity, as provided for in the Geneva Conventions, while firmly excluding, under all circumstances, the resettlement of such persons on the territory of the EU and prioritising the safe, voluntary and cost-effective return of refugees to secure zones close to their homes as the most sustainable and responsible long-term solution;
